mapper.select: SELECT outbox_id,message_id,publication_key,business_intent_key,aggregate_type, aggregate_id,contract_ref,contract_version,body_bytes,body_sha256, correlation_id,causation_id FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND publication_key=#{publicationKey}

SELECT tenant_id,outbox_id,status,attempt_count,locked_by,correlation_id,lock_version FROM outbox_event WHERE contract_ref=#{contractRef} AND contract_version=#{version} AND aggregate_type='NOTIFICATION_REQUEST' AND attempt_count<=#{outboxMaxAttempts} AND ((status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=#{now}) OR (status='PUBLISHING' AND locked_at<=#{leaseCutoff})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN next_attempt_at ELSE locked_at END,tenant_id,outbox_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT recovery_id,business_intent_key,state,attempt_count,lock_version FROM message_recovery WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{outboxId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE message_recovery SET state='OPEN',attempt_count=#{attemptCount},next_attempt_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{code}, last_error_summary=#{summary},resolved_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryId} AND state='REPLAYING' AND lock_version=#{lockVersion}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='RESOLVED',resolved_at=#{now},next_attempt_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{outboxId} AND state='REPLAYING'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,outbox_id,message_id,publication_key,business_intent_key,aggregate_type,aggregate_id, contract_ref,contract_version,body_bytes,body_sha256,correlation_id,causation_id,attempt_count, locked_by,locked_at,lock_version,created_at FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{attempts} AND locked_by=#{token} AND lock_version=#{version}
